verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs explicitly reference organizations, memberships, and org/tenant-scoped roles (e.g., migration package includes 'users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files', and RBAC docs describe org-scoped role assignment), supporting core multi-tenant modeling primitives. However, there is no explicit documentation in the evidence pack of an out-of-the-box invitation flow (e.g., inviting members to an organization via API/dashboard) beyond a generic mention of 'self-serve onboarding' for IT admins. Missing for 10: explicit invitation-flow API/docs, dashboard UI walkthrough for inviting org members, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full org+membership+invite lifecycle.
